posts.community: Anondita Medicare: the next compounder after Cupid
posts.text: Hi everyone, I’ve been following Anondita Medicare for a while now and thought it’d be good to open a thread here to discuss the stock. Sharing what I’ve gathered so far: Key Highlight: Aggressive capex: The company is going from 806M → ~1,900M+ male condom capacity in roughly 12–18 months, plus a 240M female condom plant on top. Total capex commitment is ~₹130 Cr (₹75 Cr male + ₹54.6 Cr female). Tgt- 1000cr revenue in next 2 years.
